dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmmm... The golden designs you speak of are probably those "Iridescent Inscriptions"...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Though sometimes, Paimon can't see them where you say they are...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No need for you to start "wrooing", it's better not to see some things...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} and {NICKNAME}, you two be careful, okay?
